prose_definitions.name: conductance of a graph
prose_definitions.literal_zh: Phi 为 |partial A| / deg(A) 在所有 0 < deg(A) <= |E| 的 A 上的最小值

prose_definitions.name: mixing time and relaxation time of a graph
prose_definitions.literal_zh: tmix 为最小 t（自然数）使所有 A 的 |P(X_t in A) - |A|/n| <= 1/4；trel = 1/(1-lambda_2)

prose_definitions.name: directed graph distance for a chain
prose_definitions.literal_zh: dist(x,y) 为最小 k 使 P^k(x,y) > 0；不必然对称

prose_definitions.name: W transport distance and directed lip norm
prose_definitions.literal_zh: W(mu,nu) 为 E[dist(X,Y)] 在所有边缘为 mu,nu 的耦合上的下确界；lip(f) = sup_{y~x} (f(y)-f(x))；Kantorovich 对偶写作 sup{nu f - mu f : lip(f) <= 1}

prose_definitions.name: non-negative curvature
prose_definitions.label: def:curvature
prose_definitions.literal_zh: 对所有 mu,nu：W(mu P, nu P) <= W(mu,nu)

prose_definitions.name: conjugacy-invariant support
prose_definitions.label: assume:conjugacy
prose_definitions.literal_zh: 对所有 z：z S z^{-1} = S，其中 S = {z : mu(z) > 0}

prose_definitions.name: invariant distribution and mixing time for a general chain
prose_definitions.literal_zh: pi = pi P 唯一不变分布；tmix 为最小 t >= 0 使 dtv(t) <= 1/4，dtv(t) = max_x tv(P^t(x,.), pi)

prose_definitions.name: averaged mixing time, mean displacement, escape probability
prose_definitions.literal_zh: tmix^sharp 用 pi 加权的 tv 平均；平均位移 E[dist(X0,Xt)] 以 X0 依 pi；Phi(P^t) 为 0 < pi(A) <= 1/2 时的逃逸概率最小值
